passages.text: Some time later, David defeated the Philistines, subdued them, and took Metheg-ammah from the hand of the Philistines.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Some time passed.
David fought against the Philistines.
David defeated the Philistines.
David made the Philistines submit to him.
David took Metheg-ammah from the Philistines.
passages.original: וַֽיְהִי֙ אַֽחֲרֵי־ כֵ֔ן וַיַּ֥ךְ דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ פְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וַיַּכְנִיעֵ֑ם וַיִּקַּ֥ח דָּוִ֛ד אֶת־ מֶ֥תֶג הָאַמָּ֖ה מִיַּ֥ד פְּלִשְׁתִּֽים׃

passages.text: David also defeated the Moabites, made them lie down on the ground, and measured them off with a cord. He measured off with two lengths those to be put to death, and with one length those to be spared. So the Moabites became subject to David and brought him tribute.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
David fought against the Moabites.
David defeated the Moabites.
David made the Moabites lie down on the ground.
David used a cord to measure the Moabites.
David measured two lengths of the cord for those who would be put to death.
David measured one length of the cord for those who would be spared.
The Moabites became servants to David.
The Moabites brought tribute to David.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ אֶת־ מוֹאָ֗ב וַֽיְמַדְּדֵ֤ם בַּחֶ֙בֶל֙ הַשְׁכֵּ֣ב אוֹתָ֣ם אַ֔רְצָה וַיְמַדֵּ֤ד שְׁנֵֽי־ חֲבָלִים֙ לְהָמִ֔ית וּמְלֹ֥א הַחֶ֖בֶל לְהַחֲי֑וֹת וַתְּהִ֤י מוֹאָב֙ לְדָוִ֔ד לַעֲבָדִ֖ים נֹשְׂאֵ֥י מִנְחָֽה׃

passages.text: David also defeated Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah, who had marched out to restore his dominion along the Euphrates River.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
Hadadezer was king of Zobah.
Hadadezer was the son of Rehob.
Hadadezer marched out to the Euphrates River.
He wanted to restore his power there.
David fought against Hadadezer.
David defeated Hadadezer.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣ךְ דָּוִ֔ד אֶת־ הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה בְּלֶכְתּ֕וֹ לְהָשִׁ֥יב יָד֖וֹ בִּֽנְהַר־׃

passages.text: David captured from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand charioteers, and twenty thousand foot soldiers, and he hamstrung all the horses except a hundred he kept for the chariots.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David fought against Hadadezer, king of Zobah.
David captured many soldiers and chariots from Hadadezer.
David took one thousand chariots.
David took seven thousand charioteers.
David took twenty thousand foot soldiers.
David hamstrung all the horses from the chariots.
David kept only one hundred horses for the chariots.
passages.original: וַיִּלְכֹּ֨ד דָּוִ֜ד מִמֶּ֗נּוּ אֶ֤לֶף וּשְׁבַע־ מֵאוֹת֙ פָּרָשִׁ֔ים וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף אִ֣ישׁ רַגְלִ֑י וַיְעַקֵּ֤ר דָּוִד֙ אֶת־ כָּל־ הָרֶ֔כֶב וַיּוֹתֵ֥ר מִמֶּ֖נּוּ מֵ֥אָה רָֽכֶב׃

passages.text: When the Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah, David struck down twenty-two thousand men.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Hadadezer was the king of Zobah.
The Arameans lived in Damascus.
The Arameans of Damascus came to help King Hadadezer of Zobah.
David fought against the Arameans.
David struck down twenty-two thousand Aramean men.
passages.original: וַתָּבֹא֙ אֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק לַעְזֹ֕ר לַהֲדַדְעֶ֖זֶר מֶ֣לֶךְ צוֹבָ֑ה וַיַּ֤ךְ דָּוִד֙ בַּֽאֲרָ֔ם עֶשְׂרִֽים־ וּשְׁנַ֥יִם אֶ֖לֶף אִֽישׁ׃

passages.text: Then he placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus, and the Arameans became subject to David and brought him tribute. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David placed garrisons in Aram of Damascus.
The Arameans became subject to David.
The Arameans brought tribute to David.
The LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם דָּוִ֤ד נְצִבִים֙ בַּאֲרַ֣ם דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וַתְּהִ֤י אֲרָם֙ לְדָוִ֔ד לַעֲבָדִ֖ים נוֹשְׂאֵ֣י מִנְחָ֑ה וַיֹּ֤שַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: And David took the gold shields that belonged to the officers of Hadadezer and brought them to Jerusalem.
passages.sermon:
David was the king of Israel.
Hadadezer was the king of Zobah.
Hadadezer had officers who served him.
These officers owned gold shields.
David took the gold shields from the officers of Hadadezer.
David brought the gold shields to Jerusalem.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח דָּוִ֗ד אֵ֚ת שִׁלְטֵ֣י הַזָּהָ֔ב אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָי֔וּ אֶ֖ל עַבְדֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וַיְבִיאֵ֖ם יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

passages.text: And from Betah and Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, King David took a large amount of bronze.
passages.sermon:
King David was the ruler of Israel.
Hadadezer was the king of Zobah.
Betah and Berothai were cities that belonged to Hadadezer.
King David took a large amount of bronze from Betah and Berothai.
passages.original: וּמִבֶּ֥טַח וּמִבֵּֽרֹתַ֖י עָרֵ֣י הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר לָקַ֞ח הַמֶּ֧לֶךְ דָּוִ֛ד נְחֹ֖שֶׁת הַרְבֵּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃ס

passages.text: When King Toi of Hamath heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer, he sent his son Joram to greet King David and bless him for fighting and defeating Hadadezer, who had been at war with Toi. Joram brought with him articles of silver and gold and bronze, and King David dedicated these to the LORD, along with the silver and gold he had dedicated from all the nations he had subdued— from Edom and Moab, from the Ammonites and Philistines and Amalekites, and from the spoil of Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
passages.sermon:
King Toi ruled Hamath.
King Toi heard news about David.
David had defeated the entire army of Hadadezer.
Hadadezer had fought wars against Toi.
King Toi sent his son Joram to King David.
Joram came to greet King David.
Joram came to bless David.
Joram blessed David because David fought Hadadezer and defeated him.
Joram brought articles of silver, gold, and bronze.
King David took these articles.
King David dedicated these articles to the LORD.
David also dedicated silver and gold from other nations he had conquered.
David had conquered Aram, Moab, the Ammonites, the Philistines, and the Amalekites.
David also took spoil from Hadadezer son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
David dedicated all these treasures to the LORD.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁמַ֕ע תֹּ֖עִי מֶ֣לֶךְ חֲמָ֑ת כִּ֚י הִכָּ֣ה דָוִ֔ד אֵ֖ת כָּל־ חֵ֥יל הֲדַדְעָֽזֶר׃ וַיִּשְׁלַ֣ח תֹּ֣עִי אֶת־ יֽוֹרָם־ בְּנ֣וֹ אֶל־ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ־ דָּ֠וִד לִשְׁאָל־ ל֨וֹ לְשָׁל֜וֹם וּֽלְבָרֲכ֗וֹ עַל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִלְחַ֤ם בַּהֲדַדְעֶ֙זֶר֙ וַיַּכֵּ֔הוּ כִּי־ אִ֛ישׁ מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת תֹּ֖עִי הָיָ֣ה הֲדַדְעָ֑זֶר וּבְיָד֗וֹ הָי֛וּ כְּלֵֽי־ כֶ֥סֶף וּכְלֵֽי־ זָהָ֖ב וּכְלֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃ גַּם־ אֹתָ֕ם הִקְדִּ֛ישׁ הַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִ֖ד לַֽיהוָ֑ה עִם־ הַכֶּ֤סֶף וְהַזָּהָב֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִקְדִּ֔ישׁ מִכָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר כִּבֵּֽשׁ׃ מֵאֲרָ֤ם וּמִמּוֹאָב֙ וּמִבְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֔וֹן וּמִפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וּמֵֽעֲמָלֵ֑ק וּמִשְּׁלַ֛ל הֲדַדְעֶ֥זֶר בֶּן־ רְחֹ֖ב מֶ֥לֶךְ צוֹבָֽה׃

passages.text: And David made a name for himself when he returned from striking down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David fought against the Edomites.
David defeated eighteen thousand Edomites.
This battle happened in the Valley of Salt.
David returned from this victory.
David became famous because of this victory.
passages.original: וַיַּ֤עַשׂ דָּוִד֙ שֵׁ֔ם בְּשֻׁב֕וֹ מֵהַכּוֹת֥וֹ אֶת־ אֲרָ֖ם בְּגֵיא־ מֶ֑לַח שְׁמוֹנָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר אָֽלֶף׃

passages.text: He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and all the Edomites were subject to David. So the LORD made David victorious wherever he went.
passages.sermon:
David was king of Israel.
David placed garrisons in Edom.
He put garrisons throughout all Edom.
All the people of Edom became servants to David.
The LORD gave David victory in everything he did.
The LORD helped David wherever he went.
passages.original: וַיָּ֨שֶׂם בֶּאֱד֜וֹם נְצִבִ֗ים בְּכָל־ אֱדוֹם֙ שָׂ֣ם נְצִבִ֔ים וַיְהִ֥י כָל־ אֱד֖וֹם עֲבָדִ֣ים לְדָוִ֑ד וַיּ֤וֹשַׁע יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ דָּוִ֔ד בְּכֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר הָלָֽךְ׃

passages.text: Thus David reigned over all Israel and administered justice and righteousness for all his people: Joab son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat son of Ahilud was the recorder; Zadok son of Ahitub and Ahimelech son of Abiathar were priests; Seraiah was the scribe; Benaiah son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and Pelethites; and David’s sons were priestly leaders.
passages.sermon:
David was king over all Israel.
David ruled all the people of Israel.
David gave justice to his people.
David did what was right for everyone.
Joab was the son of Zeruiah.
Joab led the army.
Jehoshaphat was the son of Ahilud.
Jehoshaphat kept the records.
Zadok was the son of Ahitub.
Ahimelech was the son of Abiathar.
Zadok and Ahimelech served as priests.
Seraiah was the scribe.
Benaiah was the son of Jehoiada.
Benaiah was in charge of the Cherethites and the Pelethites.
David’s sons were leaders among the priests.
passages.original: וַיִּמְלֹ֥ךְ דָּוִ֖ד עַל־ כָּל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיְהִ֣י דָוִ֗ד עֹשֶׂ֛ה מִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה לְכָל־ עַמּֽוֹ׃ וְיוֹאָ֥ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֖ה עַל־ הַצָּבָ֑א וִיהוֹשָׁפָ֥ט בֶּן־ אֲחִיל֖וּד מַזְכִּֽיר׃ וְצָד֧וֹק בֶּן־ אֲחִיט֛וּב וַאֲחִימֶ֥לֶךְ בֶּן־ אֶבְיָתָ֖ר כֹּהֲנִ֑ים וּשְׂרָיָ֖ה סוֹפֵֽר׃ וּבְנָיָ֙הוּ֙ בֶּן־ יְה֣וֹיָדָ֔ע וְהַכְּרֵתִ֖י וְהַפְּלֵתִ֑י וּבְנֵ֥י דָוִ֖ד כֹּהֲנִ֥ים הָיֽוּ׃פ
